overlooked_insights.title: KOSPI margin call cascade for MU
overlooked_insights.insight: The crash in Korean semiconductor stocks (KOSPI), heavily weighted in Samsung and SK Hynix, triggered a wave of retail margin calls that directly impacted MU as a DRAM competitor. Leveraged ETF holders in SOXL are forced to liquidate, amplifying the sell-off. Users track the KOSPI pre-market in real time.
overlooked_insights.evidence: Multiple users reference 'KOSPI', 'KOSPI PM', and 'SOXL korean gods!!' to describe the driving force behind the memory stock collapse. One user wrote 'MU 12 min to kospi pm' showing live monitoring.
overlooked_insights.why_overlooked: Mainstream headlines blame SK Hynix's earnings miss but ignore the Korean retail margin call mechanics that propagate the sell-off across DRAM stocks.

overlooked_insights.title: MSFT accounting change boosts earnings
overlooked_insights.insight: Microsoft extended the useful life of its infrastructure assets from 15 to 25 years, lowering depreciation and inflating reported earnings. This change, effective Q1 FY27, is a subtle earnings quality factor that flatters the headline beat.
overlooked_insights.evidence: User messages: 'shelf life of infrastructure increased from 15 yrs to over 25 yrs' and 'extending the useful life... effective starting Q1 FY27'.
overlooked_insights.why_overlooked: Headlines celebrate the earnings beat and Azure milestone without scrutinizing the accounting policy change that boosted profits.

overlooked_insights.title: Sandisk gross margin surge and no debt
overlooked_insights.insight: Sandisk reported gross margins expanding from 23% to 78% year-over-year, zero long-term debt, and Q4 revenue guidance at an $8B midpoint. These fundamentals are far stronger than the stock's 54% July decline suggests.
overlooked_insights.evidence: One user posted: 'SanDisk's gross margin expanded to 78% from 23% a year ago, carrying zero long-term debt and guiding Q4 revenue to an $8 billion midpoint.'
overlooked_insights.why_overlooked: Mainstream coverage fixates on the stock's massive drop and analyst targets, ignoring the underlying margin and debt improvement.

overlooked_insights.title: QQQ overweight MSFT masks breadth
overlooked_insights.insight: The QQQ ETF is nearly twice as heavy in Microsoft as in Meta. A strong MSFT earnings can prop up the entire index, masking weakness in other components.
overlooked_insights.evidence: User wrote: '$QQQ is almost 2x heavier in MSFT than META'.
overlooked_insights.why_overlooked: Mainstream discussion of QQQ's drop focuses on broad tech selloff, not the structural concentration risk from MSFT's overweight.

overlooked_insights.title: Qualcomm warns of accelerated Apple revenue decline
overlooked_insights.insight: Qualcomm guided an acceleration in the decline of Apple product revenues starting in Q4 fiscal 2026 due to supply constraints. This is a more concrete negative signal for Apple's chip sourcing than the generic 'phone woes' narrative.
overlooked_insights.evidence: User quoted Qualcomm: 'as a result of our supply constraints, we now expect an acceleration in the step down of Apple product revenues, starting in the fourth fiscal quarter'.
overlooked_insights.why_overlooked: Headlines mention 'tepid profit forecast' and 'phone woes' but miss the specific 'acceleration' language and direct Apple link.
